requirements.requirement: The system must render the overall score value correctly in the MessageBubble component when provided a valid explainability payload.
The system must render a list of measures with their names and values when the payload includes a non-empty measures array.
The system must render contribution breakdown values (e.g., percentages or weights) aligned with each measure when provided in the payload.
The system must correctly handle and render partial weight data by displaying available contributions without crashing or misaligning measures.
The system must render a fallback UI state when the measures array is empty, without displaying broken or undefined elements.
The system must not throw runtime errors when the explainability payload is missing optional fields such as weights or contributions.
The system must gracefully handle malformed payload structures by skipping invalid sections and still rendering valid portions of the data.
The system must ensure that measure rows render in the same order as provided in the payload.
The system must display numeric values (scores and contributions) in a consistent and formatted manner (e.g., fixed decimal or percentage format).
The system must pass unit tests verifying that no undefined or null values are rendered in the DOM for valid payloads.
The system must pass UI tests confirming that the explainability section is conditionally rendered only when explainability data is present.
The system must ensure that malformed payloads do not block rendering of the rest of the MessageBubble content.
